cards.name: Model Gateway
cards.hint: OpenAI-compatible proxy (LiteLLM). Routes inference to llama.cpp.
cards.notes: User-facing Open link = the LiteLLM admin UI at /ui/ (swagger at /), which must be served from an origin ROOT (root-absolute asset paths) - hence the `llm` subdomain, not a /llm/ subpath. `sso_path` plus the render-derived `sso_port` (MODEL_GATEWAY_EDGE_SITE in ordo/render/engine.py) are the sidecar-off fallback (https://<host>:<sso_port>/ui/); see services_catalog.service_open_url().
